top_signals.title: Ocean Freight Rates Surge +400% — But Demand Isn’t Driving It
top_signals.summary:
Ocean freight spot rates have skyrocketed by over 400%, but surprisingly, demand isn’t the primary cause. This SONAR Update breaks down how capacity control and strategic blank sailings by concentrated ocean carriers are driving prices. Plus, we dive into the state of trucking tender rejections, rising operating costs, and the shift towards a more regulated […]

top_signals.title: Why Shared Truckload Wins When Truckload Rates Rise
top_signals.summary:
Shared truckload could cut shipping costs 30% to 40% as truckload rates climb. top_signals.title: Texas Grid Forecasts Record Demand as Heat Builds, Wind Sags
top_signals.summary: The largest Texas grid is bracing for another bout of searing heat that threatens to topple its all-time power demand record yet again, just as wind generation is predicted to take a dive.
